title: Checkpoint: slide the window
prompt: A sensor stream is a string of digits. A reading is 'stable' if some **3-character window** has all digits equal. Implement `hasStable(String s)`: true if such a window exists, false otherwise — including when the string is **shorter than 3** (no full window can exist).

tests.name: stable window
tests.hint: Loop windows i..i+2 while i+2 < s.length(); compare three chars. Short strings skip the loop and return false.
